items.summary: 全线车站主体结构封顶，区间贯通，附属结构完成96%，设备安装及装修完成90%，现处于空载试运行阶段，年底基本具备开通条件。
items.summary_en: All stations topped out and intervals connected, ancillary works 96% complete, equipment and finishing 90% complete; now in no-load trial operation, basically ready for opening by year-end.
